event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Utilities squeeze, AI-hardware fades.
Sept ADP came in at 2.375 vs 2 prior, NFP printed 2.9万 vs 9万 fc, and wages cooled to +0.1% vs +0.3% fc — a soft-labor tape that let the S&P 500 print a fresh record high while XLU ripped +2.98% and semis went flat. Money rotated into power, uranium and defensives, out of biotech and memory.

INDICES — VIX 15.0, VIXY -2.66%.
RSP +0.57%, SPY +0.55%, DIA +0.48%, QQQ +0.46%, IWM -0.72%. Large > small by 0.67pp; SOXX -0.01%. Biggest cross-asset move: nat gas UNG +1.80%; UUP -0.31%.

VOLUME & BREADTH — RSP 1.7x, XLU 1.7x, XLRE 1.2x gaining attention; IJM/IJH 0.7x, SOXX 0.7x, XLY 0.9x ignored. SPY is not in the reported vol set; QQQ vol sits near the 0.88x index average — low-conviction. RSP volume up 1.7x with price up 0.57% = genuine accumulation in equal-weight, not just mega-cap drift. Breadth: 69% advancers, up/down volume 2.37, but only 29% above 50-DMA and 46% above 200-DMA, 25 new highs vs 15 lows — participation diverges from the record-high index.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLU Utilities +2.98%, XLY Discretionary +1.18%, XLRE Real Estate +1.06%, XLP Staples +0.94%, XLI Industrials +0.87%, XLK Technology +0.53%, XLE Energy +0.47%, XLB Materials +0.46%, XLF Financials +0.24%, XLC Comms +0.04%, XLV Healthcare -0.17%. Top industries: UTES +5.59%, URA +4.01%; bottom: DRAM -3.49%, XBI -3.39%. Flows: XLU +$1,815mm (100p) and XLC +$716mm (98p) in, XLF -$2,014mm (0p) and XLE -$890mm (2p) out. Money went into power/uranium and defensives, out of banks and biotech. Rotation state: defensive risk-off.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.22 = real protection demand; QQQ 1.02 neutral, IWM 0.66 complacent. SPY skew +3.8%, QQQ +4.8%, IWM +4.9% all put-premium. VIX 15.0 sits below its 15.9 20-day MA — complacency — while GEX flip 780 vs spot near highs caps upside; VIXEQ 38.2 vs VIX 15.0 is a wide gap = rotation, stock-picker tape.

CROSS-ASSET — Gold GLD +0.72% and silver SLV +0.58% up with dollar UUP -0.31% down: metals catching a soft-labor bid even as oil USO +0.64% grinds. Long bonds TLT +0.22% barely moved — wages +0.1% didn't unlock duration. Next FOMC Oct 28; Polymarket prices 82% no change (5d +9pp) and 16% for a 25bp hike.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 57.3, Neutral.
CEG +12.25% (4.3x vol, gap-up, no firm catalyst in feed), VST +10.77% on a $4B nuclear loan, CCJ +6.35% on Korea's $120B reactor framework. Momentum: MTUM BULL z+0.66 at 195 days. Watch XBI -3.39% (1.9x vol, diverging from record tape), MRVL +5.81% (3.0x vol spike vs SOXX -0.01% divergence), and GLD (20d -4.37% against a softening dollar).
